World Cup celebrations in Mexico marred by deaths

Three people died amidst large-scale World Cup celebrations in Mexico City. The events occurred in Mexican stadiums where masked wrestlers, part of 'lucha libre', were also featured, drawing attention from fans. The celebrations were reportedly widespread.
